published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The mapping is uninitialized, resulting in a rollback of the calculation with a divide-by-zero error.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Logic should be added to the contract to allow administrators to correctly initialize or update the numElements map each time a new generation is created.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: In the constructor, only the 0th Generation (Generation 0) is initialized as 3, while subsequent generations (Generation 1, Generation 2, etc.) are not initialized.
